name: Plant First Aid Diagnosis
description: Plant disease diagnosis using embedded expert knowledge base. Demonstrates nocode path pipeline: knowledge indexing → semantic matching → AI diagnosis. No code required — domain expert writes Markdown, the path engine orchestrates tc-markdown + ai-inference.
description_zh: 基于嵌入式专家知识库的盆栽病害诊断。演示无代码路径管道：知识索引 → 语义匹配 → AI 诊断。无需编码——领域专家写 Markdown，路径引擎编排 tc-markdown + ai-inference。

directives.usage_zh: 家庭园艺;诊断,<症状描述>
directives.description: Diagnose plant problems from natural language symptom description using embedded knowledge base and AI inference.
directives.description_zh: 根据自然语言症状描述诊断盆栽问题，基于嵌入式知识库和 AI 推理。

params_desc.symptoms: 用自然语言描述植物症状

directives.estimated_time_note: 取决于 AI 推理响应时间，通常 10-30 秒
directives.source: 张师傅口述,十年花店经验
